video_title: Jaylen Brown & VJ Edgecombe Speak On Their First NBA Game With LeBron James!

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown explains his motivation for starting his own streaming channel
quotes.excerpt: The reason why I started streaming in the first place was just to give people a better understanding of me
quotes.quote: The reason why I started streaming in the first place was just to give people a better understanding of me versus these third-party places that are telling you who Jaylen Brown is. Now you get to chime in once every few weeks or once a week to kind of figure it out for yourself. A lot of times there will be a lot of clickbait going on, a lot of misinformation, so you be safe out here because a lot of these corporations, they stand for weird things. They be doing weird stuff, and then they be trying to promote stuff that they want to promote because they're socially engineering you to think a certain way.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on the significance of representing the Bahamas in the Olympics
quotes.excerpt: I would rather do that than win a championship.

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: What would it mean for you to represent the Bahamas in the Olympics?

text_blocks.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
text_blocks.text: I'll be honest, that's more important. It might sound crazy, but I would rather do that than win a championship.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on the impact of Bahamas basketball on the next generation
quotes.excerpt: It will bring more attention for other kids in that position that don't have a platform.
quotes.quote: It is more so for the community and for the country. If you think about it, it will bring more attention for other kids in that position that don't have a platform. Now everyone is starting to look into the Bahamas, or just even at least kind of notice them. I've been to all these different camps, I was a notice early, so that's how it would be. I think that will help show that we got a little.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the importance of sports beyond just analytics
quotes.excerpt: Analytics don't measure what you just said, how that measures the community, the next generation.
quotes.quote: That's what people don't understand about sports is that analytics don't measure what you just said. What you just said, how that measures the community, the next generation, and how that inspires people. The analytics that measure Bahamas basketball and talent don't necessarily have a metric that equates to what that impacts on the community, how big that would be just to even make it.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his experience with the USA team in the FIBA World Cup
quotes.excerpt: I've had that experience and we lost in the FIBA World Cup.
quotes.quote: It's a great honor to represent your country. Unfortunately, I've had that experience and we lost in the FIBA World Cup. And then I wanted to get that experience again, I don't think I will, just because of other reasons. I don't think I'll be able to play for the USA team, but even being able to go back and look into my ancestry and my DNA, I would be open into exploring what that would be.
